breakdown.description: The asymmetric support pair is replaced by the same roller direction on both vertical edges
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use the same roller direction (u_x = 0) on both vertical edges, which contradicted the intended asymmetric support. The ground truth corrected this to `u_y = 0` on the left and `u_x = 0` on the right. The generated specification correctly implemented the asymmetric constraints by stating: 'The left edge of the plate has a displacement constraint of u_y = 0' and 'The right edge of the plate has a displacement constraint of u_x = 0'.
